hook: That little door on your washer? Almost nobody opens it.
doThis: Behind it sits the pump filter.

steps.say: Unplug it, let any hot water cool, and open the flap.
Put a tray down and slowly unscrew the filter.
Pull out the lint and coins, then rinse it.

safety.say: Expect more water than you think.
safety.text: Hot water? Let it cool first.

result.say: No more slow draining or funky smells.
result.headline: Drains like new
